item.title: Said & Checked, West Virginia, 2026-11-20: none false or contradicted, 1 unsupported, 2 unsettled (Shelley Moore Capito)
item.description:
No statement was found false or contradicted.

Unsupported and Unsettled

  • Shelley Moore Capito, U.S. Senator: “Even the Wall Street Journal and the New York Times have endorsed the passage of this.” Unsupported. No Wall Street Journal or New York Times editorial on the bill was found; the search covered web searches for both papers' editorials, and their sites were not fetched directly.
  • Shelley Moore Capito, U.S. Senator: “The Bipartisan American Affordability and Jobs Act enjoys the support of influential renewable energy groups, like American Clean Power Association and American Council on Renewable Energy, while it is also supported by conventional energy leaders, like American Petroleum Institute and…” Unsettled. The American Petroleum Institute published a statement supporting S. 5653 on Sept. 30, 2026, but no statement on this bill from the American Clean Power Association or the American Council on Renewable Energy was found.
  • Shelley Moore Capito, U.S. Senator: “We also worked together on a list of 19 amendments to receive votes--11 from Senate Democrats, 7 from Senate Republicans, plus the bipartisan managers' amendment.” Unsettled. Sen. Merkley objected to Capito's unanimous consent requests, so no agreement listing the amendment votes was adopted, and no official list of 19 amendments was found to confirm the breakdown.

8 statements by 2 officeholders. 7 checked: 4 supported, 2 unsettled, 1 unsupported · 1 not checkable.
